notes.title: 🏎️💨 Introducing our next game - Golden Lap 🍾🏆
notes.content:
It's been a long time since we've announced a new game. 5 years. Lots has been happening behind the scenes with games we wanted to work on, but now we can finally show something official! 

[h3]We're happy to announce Golden Lap!![/h3]

[previewyoutube=f4AzzhL4ZKc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Manage your own iconic open-wheel racing team and blow your rivals away!![/b]

Go back in time with our new racing strategy game Golden Lap, developed together with our friends at [url=https://www.strelkagames.com/]Strelka Games[/url]! 

Become the Team Principal of a racing team in the tumultuous Golden Era of Open-Wheel Racing. Manage your team in style and oversee thrilling races to pave the road to victory season after season.

Golden Lap will be released on Steam later this year!

[h3]Wishlist now:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052040/Golden_Lap

[b]Website:[/b] https://funselektor.com/goldenlap


[b]Subreddit:[/b] https://www.reddit.com/r/goldenlap/

tags.feature: We're happy to announce Golden Lap!!

notes.title: 2021 Update
notes.content:
This Update has a game engine update, small optimizations and bug fixes!

Features

[/list]

Improvements
[list]

[*] Performance optimization for Math libraries
[*] PS5 controller support
[*] Swapped the rising sun images with a Funselektor image
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Having Citrix installed shouldn't affect the game anymore
[/list]

notes.title: art of rally official announcement
notes.content:
[h1]"To do something dangerous with style is art..."[/h1]

Hey Everyone,

This is Dune from Funselektor Labs and this is my new racing game called art of rally coming to Steam in 2019.

Steam Page for Wishlists: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/550320/art_of_rally/ 

Race in the golden era of rally. Drive iconic cars from the 60s to Group B on challenging stages through stylized environments. Will you master the art of rally?   

Features:
• Progress through the golden years of rally in Career Mode
• 30+ iconic rally cars from the 60s, 70s, 80s, Group B and Group S
• Completely overhauled handling from the car physics system of Absolute Drift
• 50 rally stages in Finland, Sardinia, Norway, Japan and Germany
• Repair performance damage between stages 
• Daily and weekly challenges with leaderboards
• Original soundtrack by Tatreal

If you're not a beta tester yet, you can join the discord channel to participate in the Closed Beta which will happen later this year.

Discord: https://discord.gg/rPYJyjY
Website: http://artofrally.com/

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8256620/8a9ec7da0575bee8b3fdeb9ea6e557e2fcfb2b5f.png[/img]

Hello My Children,

This is a minor update which addresses a few lingering issues with Absolute Drift.

Improvements:
[list]
    [*]Game Audio mutes when minimizing the game.
    [*]Scraping the ground doesn't kill the multiplier anymore.
    [*]Wall tapping doesn't kill the multiplier as easily now. (However, if you wall-tap very hard, it will).
    [*]Added a quick restart button to the controls.
    [*]Added a clutch button to the controls.
    [*]Made the Hoonivan slightly larger to reduce its competitive advantage.
    [*]Updated the game engine to Unity 5.6.
    [*]Updated the input system, which should hopefully fix Win 10 + Xbox controller bugs.
    [*]Added more Sake.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
    [*]Controller vibration continuing after an event ends.
    [*]Car momentarily starting in reverse when restarting an event.
    [*]A couple missions in World 5 free-roam that weren't consistently detecting spins.
    [*]Falling through the level in World 5 if you hit a certain place at a certain angle.
[/list]

Post Bugs [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/611701360839562983/]Here[/url] 
Post Feedback [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/350532536104291394/?ctp=7]Here[/url] 

And follow [url=https://twitter.com/AbsoluteDrift]@AbsoluteDrift[/url] for the latest updates!

Btw, what would like you like to see in a Rally game?

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8256620/8a9ec7da0575bee8b3fdeb9ea6e557e2fcfb2b5f.png[/img]

The Zen Edition has been out for three days, and there have been many new players, along with many bugs to fix. 

Here is the latest patch and I'm working to fix new bugs as they come up!

Improvements:
[list]
    [*]Added controller logging for better controller troubleshooting
    [*]Can have more than one controller/input device plugged in (ie. steering wheel + gamepad)
    [*]Added WASD controls. (sorry I forgot!)
    [*]Game engine updated to Unity 5.3.6p2
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
    [*]Fixed controllers vibrating if the car crashes right before the pause screen or on game over.
    [*]PS4 controllers should work on SteamOS now.
    [*]Minor bug where the Lighthouse in World 5 in Free-Roam had an incorrect collider.
    [*]Max frame-rate is limited to roughly 200FPS to fix some UI glitches.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
    [*]OSX: Crash when entering midnight events. Look [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/355043117511719971/]here[/url] for updates.
[*]OSX: crash on startup. This has been temporarily fixed on some machines by skipping the Splash Screen.    
[*]Some people have reported problems completing The Completionist achievement.
    [*]Car sometimes starts in reverse or neutral when restarting an event.
    [*]Glitches with the pause screen or game over animation. Try turning v-sync on if this happens to you.
[/list]

It's been great seeing all the new feedback from the new Update, see you on the leaderboards!

Post Bugs [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/611701360839562983/]Here[/url] 
Post Feedback [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/350532536104291394/?ctp=7]Here[/url] 

And follow [url=https://twitter.com/AbsoluteDrift]@AbsoluteDrift[/url] for the latest updates!

notes.title: Absolute Drift: Zen Edition is Out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8256620/8a9ec7da0575bee8b3fdeb9ea6e557e2fcfb2b5f.png[/img]

Hello My Child, 

The Zen Edition update that I collaborated on with Flippfly is finally RELEASED!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jXREpQn6V84

We added several new features to the game for the Zen Edition, including:
[list]
    [*]New “event challenges” that will extend the gameplay in the game’s 34 tracks by challenging players to complete increasingly difficult tasks.
[*]Drift Lines: a new challenge in events where you must drift through all the dots.          
    [*]5 all new “Midnight Events.” These night-themed tracks are designed to challenge even the most experienced players.
    [*]Replays and ghost cars. View your friends' runs or the best in the world!
    [*]An all new tutorial and in-game guide to help new players ease into the game’s features and controls.
    [*]The ability to choose different controller layouts.
    [*]New input system for better controller compatibility.
    [*]Cloud saves.
[/list]

If you were playing in a beta branch, you may need to reinstall the game for access to the new update.

And if you find any bugs, please follow the instructions [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/611701360839562983/]HERE[/url] and make a bug report. 

Thanks for playing!

=========-=-=:hoonivan:-===:daswhip:

notes.title: Update #3 (Beta)
notes.content:
The game engine for Absolute Drift has been updated to the latest version which should bring more performance improvements. Also, the input system has been changed which should fix the Xbox One controller bugs. Please try it out and report any bugs in the forum!

[b]To Enable the Beta:[/b]
1.Go to your Steam Library and right click on Absolute Drift
2. Select “Properties” from the drop-down menu.
3. Select the “Betas” tab
4. Select the beta option in the drop-down menu.

NOTE: If you get a crash on startup, delete the local content and then install the game again.

Improvements:
[list]
[*]Upgraded the game engine from Unity 4 to 5. The new version has performance improvements, such as an upgraded physics system.
[*]Changed the input system which should have better support for controllers.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]If you get a crash on startup, delete the local content and then install the game again.
[*]*UPDATE: THIS IS FIXED NOW* The Mountain Drift Tracks and the Mountain Tracks in Free-Roam have an issue with the car sliding around uncontrollably. 
[*]If you still encounter crashes or problems, submit a bug report here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/611701360839562983/
[*]If you are on Linux you may have to add add this option in the steam client (in properties -> set launch options):
%command% -force-opengl
[/list]

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Update #2 - New Difficulty Options!
notes.content:
Absolute Drift was at PAX Prime and I got to see many players try the game. I even got to see a few people who have beat it which was pretty awesome.

The most notable change is a difficulty setting. The default controls are Hard. 

[b]New Difficulty Setting.[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/z5cTcDM.jpg[/img]
[b]Choose the difficulty in the Tutorial.[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/L7qnjM9.jpg[/img]
[b]New Resolution Setting.[/b]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZnyX8WM.jpg[/img]

Please try the new changes and post up in the forums with feedback.

Stay sideways my friends!

Improvements:
[list]
[*]Added a setting to change the screen resolution. In the Main Menu, go to Settings->Graphics.
[*]Added a setting to change the DIFFICULTY of the controls. The old controls are the same as Hard difficulty. In the Main Menu, go to Settings->Controls.
[*]Redesigned the layout of the tutorial.
[*]Added a timer to the Driftkhana tutorial which will automatically unlock the next challenge type after 1 minute.
[*]Made the camera look further in front of the car.
[*]Implemented anti-cheat software which prevents modifying score-related values in memory. 
[*]Spin-Zones & Spin missions are now more consistent and fair when calculating spins.
[*]Donuts & Donut missions are now more consistent and fair when calculating drifting.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
This update contains fixes and improvements based on player feedback.

It is possible to rebind keys using the game engine's (Unity3d)  built-in rebinding.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=497267636

[*]made the camera smoother when the car is spinning fast.

[list]
[*]fixed the random bug where all sounds would be muted except for the distant sound of the engine. This was to do with a Reverb bug in Unity 4, so it is now disabled.
[*]fixed a couple places players can get stuck in Free-Roam.
[/list]

notes.title: SMOOTH CAMERA UPDATE
notes.content:
There's been a lot of feedback about the camera being too shaky/wobbly/jerky.

I've taken this into account and have updated the camera to be MUCH smoother. 

The distance it looks in front of the car is now based on speed. So if the car is travelling slowly, the car will be in the middle of the screen and there will be much less wobbling.

And when the car goes faster, the camera will look further in front of the car to give a better view.

[url=http://imgur.com/OjNe0UC][img]http://i.imgur.com/OjNe0UC.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Post-Release Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, I've been working hard on fixing bugs and addressing issues players have been having since release.

I just want to say thanks to everyone who's tried out the game, I've spent over a year working on it and it makes me happy that you guys are having fun. 

[b]Formula Drift Seattle[/b] - I was lucky enough to get down there to watch the finals last weekend, check out the pics!
https://www.facebook.com/absolutedrift

[url=http://imgur.com/JGtETPw][img]http://i.imgur.com/JGtETPwm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://imgur.com/KVCLIrx][img]http://i.imgur.com/KVCLIrxm.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://imgur.com/DHu9h4U][img]http://i.imgur.com/DHu9h4Um.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://imgur.com/ehLYwaH][img]http://i.imgur.com/ehLYwaHm.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Hotfix #1[/h1]

[b]Standing Issues:[/b]
-There is still an issue where the audio will cut out randomly when you start a level, I will be looking at this issue asap.
-Camera: A lot of players are saying that the camera is a little too shaky, especially when doing spins. I am looking into this.
-A few people are having issues with controllers on various OS's. Check this thread for fixes: 
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/535152276587908545/]Controller Fixes[/url]
-disabled vibration on Windows as it may be the source of startup crashes.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
-lowered the volume of the "Go!" chime in events.
-tweaked the "Jump Over the Crane" mission in W3.
-tweaked the Turbo wastegate/blow-off valve to be easier on the ears.
-skidmarks now fade out.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-fixed the issue with monitors with high refresh rates (120hz+) not getting drift points.

I just want to say thanks to everyone who's tried out the game, I've spent over a year working on it and it makes me happy that you guys are having fun. 

[b]Formula Drift Seattle[/b] - I was lucky enough to get down there to watch the finals last weekend, check out the pics!

-A few people are having issues with controllers on various OS's. Check this thread for fixes:

notes.title: Beta 5
notes.content:
The main feature for this week is the revamped scoring system, which now has a score multiplier for drifting without crashing.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/d5qZOJo.jpg[/img]

Improvements:
[list]
[*]More car colors.
[*]Gave more final engine sounds to each car.
[*]Added many new/improved audio effects for scoring.
[*]Free-roam: Optimized the mountain meshes.
[*]Levels: Made all Mountain drift levels wider.
[*]Levels & Free-roam: Optimized all the Mtn Drift & regular drift level walls, this should fix the lag issues.
[*]Levels: Added a score multiplier which increases as you get more points. It will expire upon crashing or not drifting for a certain amount of time.
[*]Driftkhana: Donuts are now worth 5000pts, Spin-Zones are worth 3000pts.
[*]Added a "Exit to Desktop" button in the Free-Roam pause menu.
[*]All scores are now formatted with commas for readability.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug where Clipping Points would sometimes stay white.
[*]Fixed a problem with the rev limiter not limiting properly.
[*]Fixed the issue with Spin-Zones & Donuts where they would suddenly expand to their complete state instead of smoothly expanding.
[/list]

notes.title: May 15th Update
notes.content:
Hello Beta Testers!

This week was mainly about revamping the main menu, and adding more settings:
- Camera FOV
- Steering Sensitivity
- Vibration strength

Hopefully the game will run better on lower-spec machines. 

Next week I'll be working on adding more cars and improving existing ones and also improving the audio effects in the game.

If you could take some time to give some feedback on the game it would be much appreciated. Either in the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320140/discussions/0/617335934137546385/] new thread[/url] or by email at support@absolutedrift.com
